A '''Sky Judge''' was a position of authority that existed in the period of time before the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Culoph]] was a Sky Judge renowned for his legendary swordsmanship.
